description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'DestroyReportToPurgeStrategyTest' for testing the 'DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy' class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It sets up the test environment, loads fixtures, and verifies that the purge method correctly deletes 'ReportTo' entities associated with specific IDs.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of 'DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy', specifically testing the purge operation on 'ReportTo' entities to ensure they are correctly removed from the database.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by configuring the entity class name, setting up the strategy info array, creating an instance of 'DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy', and loading fixture data into the database.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Tests that the 'purge' method correctly deletes 'ReportTo' records associated with a subordinate or supervisor ID of 1, then asserts that no such records remain.
